item.title: Fix window.py bug so python3 -m unittest passes
item.brief:
Operator request (verbatim): "In this repository `python3 -m unittest` fails. Find and fix the bug in `window.py` so every test passes, without changing the tests, and make sure the function is correct for every input, not just the tested ones. Commit your fix."

Goal: `python3 -m unittest` passes in the repository root with no test changes.

Constraints:
- Do not modify any test files or test expectations; fix the implementation in `window.py`.
- The function must be correct for all valid inputs, including edge cases (empty input, single element, boundaries, off-by-one at ends), not only the cases the tests exercise. Check the edge cases explicitly by reading the code.
- Keep the change minimal and readable; add at most a short comment only if the logic is not self-explanatory.
- Commit the fix on the local branch with a clear commit message. Do not push.

Acceptance criteria:
1. `python3 -m unittest` exits 0 with all tests passing.
2. No test files changed.
3. The bug fix is verified correct for edge cases beyond the existing tests.
4. Changes are committed.

pr.body: Approach: range bound was len(items) - size, excluding the last valid start index. Changed to len(items) - size + 1. Key file: window.py (1 line). Checks: python3 -m unittest passes; edge cases checked manually. Assumptions: size <= 0 still raises ValueError as before.
pr.summary: made sliding_windows return the final window. now includes last start index. before: [1,2,3] size 2 gave [[1,2]]; now: [[1,2],[2,3]].
pr.title: Fix off-by-one that dropped the last sliding window
